Recovery & Resolution Planning (RRP) Support

• Partner with Corporate Risk, Compliance, Legal, Procurement, and Technology teams to support operational resilience programs.

• Support compliance with technology governance standards including information security, data privacy, audit, access management, SSO, MFA, and application governance requirements.
• Monitor technology performance and coordinate vendor support activities.

Real Estate/Workplace Technology Advancement

• Develop strategies for sensors, smart buildings, workplace analytics, digital signage, and reservation technologies.

• Coordinate reporting activities for management, finance, audit, and leadership teams.
• Assist with space utilization, occupancy reporting, and portfolio analytics initiatives.

Data Governance & Analytics

• Support data quality management and governance activities across real estate and workplace technology platforms.
• Validate lease, occupancy, project and portfolio data.
• Produce recurring and ad hoc reports for management and business stakeholders.
• Assist with development of dashboards, scorecards, KPIs, and executive reporting.
• Identify data inconsistencies and recommend process improvements.

Vendor Management & Procurement Support

• Manage vendor onboarding, procurement activities, contract administration, and third-party service provider relationships across technology, facilities, and real estate operations.
• Administer contracts, purchase orders, statements of work, renewals, vendor obligations, and supporting documentation to ensure compliance and operational efficiency.
• Partner with vendors, Procurement, Accounts Payable, and business stakeholders to resolve issues, review invoices, support Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) requirements, and strengthen vendor governance practices.

Compliance, Audit & Risk Support

• Organize and maintain documentation supporting audits, regulatory reviews, and internal control testing.
• Support control validation, evidence collection, issue management, and remediation tracking.
• Participate in compliance and governance initiatives supporting Global Realty Services operations.

Join a role that's central to our technological resilience, offering a unique opportunity to shape the firm's tech risk strategy and enhance industry compliance.

As a Tech Risk & Controls Director in Consumer & Community Banking, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and implementing the firm's technology risk management strategy. Leveraging your advanced knowledge and expertise in technology-risk disciplines, you will identify, oversee, and mitigate compliance and operational risks in line with the firm's standards. You will collaborate with various stakeholders, including Product Owners, Business Control Managers, and regulators, to develop and maintain a comprehensive view of the technology risk posture and its impact on the business. Your ability to make calculated decisions, manage large teams, and drive strategic projects will be crucial in ensuring the firm's adherence to regulatory obligations and industry best practices. Your work will contribute to the long-term success and resilience of the organization in an ever-evolving technology landscape.

Job responsibilities

• Develops and implements technology risk management strategies, policies, and processes that identify, assess, and mitigate risk while meeting the firm’s standards and regulatory requirements.
• Leads the transformation of technology controls from reactive remediation to a proactive, product-based operating model with defined intake, prioritization, delivery, validation, and sustainable closure processes.
• Redesigns technology controls for agentic artificial intelligence environments in which authorized AI capabilities may generate artifacts, recommend actions, or support workflow execution, with appropriate human oversight and handling of sensitive data.
• Establishes reuse-first expectations and governance standards for enterprise-authorized AI capabilities used in technology risk and controls workflows, including validation, approval, escalation, traceability, and auditability requirements.
• Develops reusable control patterns across technology domains, including identity and access management, change management, operational resilience, monitoring, data, third-party technology, and configuration management.
• Implements controls-as-code, policy-as-code, automated guardrails, continuous control signals, and automated evidence capture within technology development and operational workflows.
• Designs end-to-end traceability across control intent, actions, and outcomes, including AI-assisted actions and tool activity, to strengthen evidence quality, accountability, and audit readiness.
• Applies systems thinking, root-cause analysis, automation, and measurable feedback loops to reduce repeat issues, reopened findings, manual evidence collection, and control-related rework.
• Establishes target-state architecture, implementation roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, adoption measures, and operating routines that improve control performance and remove delivery barriers.
• Manages control reporting, issue management, action-plan governance, and performance measurement, translating control health into trusted metrics, leading indicators, and decision points for senior leaders.
• Builds strong relationships across technology, risk, cybersecurity, audit, and other functions to drive adoption of standardized controls and maintain alignment with legal, regulatory, security, and resiliency expectations.

Develop and maintain the BCM operating model, program charter, policies, procedures, methodologies, standards, and annual program plan.

Audit & Risk Transformation

• Testing & Simulation: Design and facilitate tabletop exercises, functional drills, and full-scale disaster simulations to validate readiness and uncover gaps.

• Balance independence and professional skepticism with a collaborative, pragmatic approach that enables Internal Audit and risk management to serve as valued partners to the business.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

• Cultivate a high-performing audit and risk function, leveraging audit, risk, technology, analytics, and business expertise to support Gilead’s evolving needs.

• Establish clear priorities and performance expectations while maintaining the agility to deploy resources toward Gilead’s most significant and rapidly evolving risks.
